_doc: Grand Europe 1070 reconstruction: approximate macro-regions, major powers and independent minor states. Stable 67 region / 11 faction IDs; new campaign ownership only.

campaign.dscr: Europe in 1070: Norman England, Capetian France, the Holy Roman Empire and Byzantium face rivals across a divided continent. The Seljuks advance in the east; Iberia and Rus remain politically fragmented. Borders are reconstructed macro-regions for strategy play; grey lands represent separate independent polities.

factions.dscr: Independent realms, principalities and frontier communities. Shared grey colour is a gameplay convention, not a united state.
factions.victoryMessage: Independent polities prevails across Grand Europe!

factions.dscr: William I rules England after the Norman conquest and retains Normandy across the Channel. Wales and Scotland remain independent.
factions.victoryMessage: Kingdom of England prevails across Grand Europe!

factions.dscr: Philip I is king of the Capetian realm. Royal authority is limited; Aquitaine and other great fiefs are grouped here for campaign play.
factions.victoryMessage: Kingdom of France prevails across Grand Europe!

factions.dscr: Henry IV is King of the Romans in 1070, not yet crowned emperor. The imperial sphere includes German duchies, Bohemia, Alpine marches and northern Italy.
factions.victoryMessage: Holy Roman Empire prevails across Grand Europe!

factions.dscr: Before Manzikert in 1071, Byzantium still holds the Balkan imperial provinces and most of Anatolia. Its eastern frontier faces Seljuq incursions.
factions.victoryMessage: Byzantine Empire prevails across Grand Europe!

factions.dscr: Alp Arslan rules the Great Seljuq Empire in Iran and Iraq and advances on the Armenian frontier. The Sultanate of Rum does not yet exist in 1070.
factions.victoryMessage: Great Seljuq Empire prevails across Grand Europe!

factions.dscr: The Fatimid caliph al-Mustansir rules from Cairo. Egypt, Sinai and Palestine form the campaign core; political conditions in Syria remain fragmented.
factions.victoryMessage: Fatimid Caliphate prevails across Grand Europe!

factions.dscr: The Rus' principalities are dynastically linked but politically divided. Their common playable faction is a campaign abstraction, not a centralized Russian empire.
factions.victoryMessage: Rus' Principalities prevails across Grand Europe!

factions.dscr: The Almoravids consolidate a realm in Morocco and the western Sahara. Their conquest of the Iberian taifas lies in the future; al-Andalus is independent in this scenario.
factions.victoryMessage: Almoravid Realm prevails across Grand Europe!

factions.dscr: Sweyn II rules Denmark, including Scania at this period. Norway and Sweden are separate kingdoms and are not Danish starting possessions.
factions.victoryMessage: Kingdom of Denmark prevails across Grand Europe!

factions.dscr: Sancho II rules Castile in 1070. Leon and Galicia are separate crowns, Portucale is not an independent Portuguese kingdom, and southern Iberia is divided into taifas.
factions.victoryMessage: Kingdom of Castile prevails across Grand Europe!
